questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped signs warn of danger ahead. Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of dangers in or near work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right of the divider ahead.

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mark work zones. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. You must obey the flagger's directions. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions.

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has one-way traffic. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction and maintenance work. Slow down and drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic will be merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can turn left at a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet.

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: Driving past this sign means you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a crossing road is ahead.

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path first. Stop if you need to before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs show motorist services. They tell you about rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other services nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are in or approaching a school zone. Watch for children and obey all speed limits in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go under if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending soon.

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns of a school zone or school crossing area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to maintain control and protect your brakes.

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic will be merging into your lane from the right. Be prepared to safely allow them to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight.
